synopsis: After graduating from the Korean National Police University and becoming a detective, Ji-Yong is assigned to investigate a suspicious report and comes face-to-face with a nationwide jeonse scam. title: The Flower Princess of Sylph
titleNative: シルフの花姫
synopsis: Natalia lost her family, and succeeded the throne to be the King of Ventfleur. She was known as the princess blessed by the spirits--people loved her. However, she was deep in her grief… the only thing that comforted her now was "Sylphide", the holy sword blessed by the wind spirit Sylph. The sword marked her succession to the throne, and it was said that the wielder could see the memories of the past kings by touching the sword. However, Natalia couldn't see anything… although she felt better by holding onto it. One day, a nun named Sara came to her and told her that she will make her healthy. Natalia rejected her first, but Sara won't give up. She was worried about Natalia, but also had a reason she must be by her side. (Source: Kadokawa) Note: Includes two extra chapters.

Until one day, when she met a high school girl, Sora Takamiya, who loved Gundam models, too...! When two people who love Gundam meet, it's the beginning of something new–––. A story about how it feels “to like” something; a “Gunpla” slice-of-life comedy featuring an almost-thirty OL and a JK!! title: Don Dracula
titleNative: ドン・ドラキュラ
synopsis: After living in Transylvania for several years, "Earl Dracula" (as Osamu Tezuka's official website calls him in English) has moved to Japan. In the Nerima Ward of Tokyo, he and his daughter, Chocola, and faithful servant Igor have taken up residence in an old-Western style house. While Chocola attends Junior High School, Earl Dracula is desperate to drink the blood of beautiful virgin women; an appropriate meal for a vampire of his stature. However, each night that Earl Dracula goes out on the prowl he finds himself getting involved in some kind of disturbance which leads to him causing various trouble for the local residents. With nobody in Japan believing in vampires, his very presence causes trouble amongst the people in town. (Source: Wikipedia)

title: Oosaki-san to Komori-san
titleNative: 大崎さんと小森さん
synopsis: A pure love story between two people with a 50cm height difference and mismatched appearances and personalities. The new part-timer is... a child!?!? Osaki-san is tall and has a poker face, making her seem intimidating at first glance, but she's actually shy and kind. The new employee who comes to Osaki-san's workplace is Komori-san, who is only 147cm tall and very friendly. These two, who are complete opposites in appearance and personality, find themselves drawn to each other...!? Osaki-san is clumsy and a crybaby, yet a go-getter, and Komori-san is oblivious, laid-back, and a gentle, introverted type. What will become of the love between these two, who are complete opposites and have a 50cm height difference...? This is the first installment of a hilarious and heartwarming survival-of-the-fittest (?) romantic comedy about these two quirky girls. (Source: Kadokawa, translated) Note: Originally self-published on the author's Twitter, it was later acquired by Kadokawa who released the first volume on May 11, 2026.

Left alone in the SSS-rank dungeon, Labyrinth of Yggdrasil, he prepares for death... "You're the first human to reach this far." As if being guided by something, Rei meets Norn, a mysterious girl who lives in the lowest level of the dungeon, World Tree! Rei, who obtained infinite magical power, was trained by Norn to survive in this harsh dungeon. "Norn, I..." There was something left unfinished. The boy who has become the strongest returns to earth with only one knife in his hand. The strongest high-fantasy begins here! (Source: Kadokawa, translated)

With his adult brain in a young body, he’s considered a child prodigy…until he displays the “Production Magic” skill when he turns eight. In a family that favors offensive magic, this crafting skill is considered useless in battle, and Van is banished to oversee a tiny country town in disgrace.
